PROCLAMATION OF EMERGENCY (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2001
PROCLAMATION OF
EMERGENCY (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2001
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 2 OF 2001
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th June, 2001]
No.2-10/99-Min. I, dated
20-6-2001.-- In pursuance of the Proclamation of Emergency of the
fourteenth day of October 1999, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased
to make and promulgate the following order:--
1. Short Title.--- (1)
This Order may be called the Proclamation of Emergency (Amendment) Order, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

PROCLAMATION OF

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 2 OF 2001
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th June, 2001]
No.2-10/99-Min. I, dated
20-6-2001.-- In pursuance of the Proclamation of Emergency of the
fourteenth day of October 1999, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the Chief Executive of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan is pleased
to make and promulgate the following order:--
2. In the proclamation of
Emergency of the fourteenth day of October, 1999, in paragraph (2):--
(a) for clause
(b) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(b) The
person holding the office of the President of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan
immediately before the commencement of the Proclamation of Emergency (Amendment)
Order, 2001, shall cease to hold the office with immediate effect".
(b) In clause
(c), for the word "suspended" occurring at the end, the words
"dissolved with immediate effect" shall be substituted; and
(c) for clause
(d), the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(d) The
Chairman and Deputy Chairman of the Senate have already ceased to hold office;
the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the National Assembly and the Provincial
Assemblies shall also cease to hold office with immediate effect".
